registry_info.name: progression_debug
registry_info.description: Debug and scaffold artifacts for testing the soft-stage progression system — EcosystemManager, HazardManager, CatalystCapabilityManager.

soft_stage_dashboard.name: Soft Stage Dashboard
soft_stage_dashboard.description: Wall-mounted read-only panel showing live state from EcosystemManager, HazardManager, and CatalystCapabilityManager. Three-column layout with allow flags, hazard types and personalities, capacity level and hand verbs. Rolling signal log at the bottom captures all manager events with timestamps.

dna.default: report=all, mounting=wall - the shipped three-column layout at a third of the panel each, and no body under the quad. The column x positions, the divider positions and the label wrap width all fall out of the general code at panel_size.x / 3, so the 7 existing placements are unchanged.
dna.was: three co-equal columns hard-coded at a third of the panel each, so every room made the same claim about the world - that ecosystem, hazards and capability weigh the same - whether or not the room was about all three; and a quad floating at the placement origin with nothing holding it, despite a docstring calling it wall-mounted
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the sweep refused this artifact because panel_size was its only export and a size is not an argument. The argument-carrying constants were inside the builder: which managers get a column, and what body the readout has. Manager signals stay connected in every report mode, so the signal log still records all three - only the readout narrows.

progression_driver.name: Progression Driver
progression_driver.description: Interactive VR control panel to advance through sequences, befriend hazards, and reset progression on all three managers. Slider selects sequence, buttons trigger force_advance_to or reset_progression. Dynamically generates befriend buttons for all hazard types found in soft_stages.json.
